about: the lock: every stand-in trained and matched in strength (or, in the no-stall world, trained at its locked coefficient), written before any return, points or score of any trained arm is computed
approval: not read: training, matching, the lock and the evaluations do not depend on the user's choice of mark forms (all eight forms are trained, matched and scored either way); only the marks look reads approval.json (spec change C6)

classifier_ratio.formula: softplus(log w(s_i, a) - l*), log w = the logit of a classifier g of target pairs (s_i, clip(pi(s_i) + a_i - c(s_i), -1, 1)) against recorded pairs (s_i, a_i), refitted every 4,000 steps with the arm's own actor; l* = log(0.1 / 0.9 * sum_{j in bank} w(s_j, a_j))

classifier_ratio[fitted with the cloned.formula: softplus(log w(s_i, a) - l*), log w = the logit of a classifier g of target pairs (s_i, clip(pi(s_i) + a_i - c(s_i), -1, 1)) against recorded pairs (s_i, a_i), refitted every 4,000 steps with the arm's own actor; l* = log(0.1 / 0.9 * sum_{j in bank} w(s_j, a_j))

density.formula: [N(s_i, a) - N(s_i, a_i)]_+, N(s, a) = 1/2 sum_k ((a_k - c_k(s)) / sigma_k)^2, c the cloned actor, sigma_k^2 = mean_i (a_ik - c_k(s_i))^2 over the training rows (maximum likelihood)

density_plan.formula: [N(s_i, a) - q95_N]_+, q95_N the split-conformal 95% level of N on 5,000 held-out recorded rows (the plan's recipe: sigma from the training rows, q95 from held-out rows; at training states this level is about the 99.5% point, spec change C1)

distance.formula: [f(s_i, a) - f(s_i, a_i)]_+, f a smooth surface (MLP) fitted to d10(s, a), the distance to the 10th-nearest training row in standard units of (state, command)

distance_plan.formula: [f(s_i, a) - q95_d]_+, q95_d the split-conformal 95% level of the exact d10 on 5,000 held-out recorded rows

e.note: reported for every stand-in, not a stop condition (spec 'check_e'); the classifier ratio is read with its classifier fitted with the no-caution actor, and also with the cloned actor (the classifier every arm starts from)

range_hinge.formula: 100 * sum_j ([a_j - hi_j]_+^2 + [lo_j - a_j]_+^2), lo_j, hi_j the 0.5% and 99.5% quantiles of the gapped training commands per thruster (the room's range_hinge, unchanged)

two_head.formula: [D(s_i, a) - D(s_i, a_i)]_+, D(s, a) = |Q1(s, a) - Q2(s, a)| of the frozen critic

two_head_plan.formula: |Q1(s_i, a) - Q2(s_i, a)| of the frozen critic (the plan's literal form)

label: EXPLORATORY: Stage 1 data-only stand-ins in the lower-edge channel (plan section 4.2), computed outside the gate on saved gate artifacts and the room test's locked strengths; not a gated output; changes no pre-registered rule; no BCA band, calibrator, threshold, dose or BCA update was used (data-only stand-ins only)

density.note: sigma is fitted on the training rows, the rows the cloned actor was fitted on; q95_N is taken on held-out rows, where the scatter around the cloned actor is wider (held_out_rms_over_sigma); see density_levels and spec change C1

density_levels.note: half a chi-square with 4 degrees of freedom exceeds q with probability exp(-q)(1 + q); the same-rows level is reported only (spec change C1)

query_types: no-caution actor with one thruster at 0.6-1.0

held_out.rule: calibration split, gap removed, bank rows left out; default_rng([20261015, seed, 81])
